definitions.gloss: landing; touching down; alighting on the ground
definitions.explanation: The moment of making contact with the ground after being in the air, whether from a jump, flight, or fall. Used for people, aircraft, and spacecraft.

examples.japanese: {着地|ちゃくち}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{失敗|しっぱい}→失敗：01636_shippai⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{足|あし}→足：00575_ashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{捻|ひね}った→捻る：00102_hineru⟧。
examples.english: I failed the landing and twisted my ankle.

examples.japanese: ⟦{体操|たいそう}{選手|せんしゅ}→体操選手：25172_taisousenshu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見事|みごと}→見事：03744_migoto⟧な{着地|ちゃくち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{決|き}めた→決める：00858_kimeru⟧。
examples.english: The gymnast stuck a perfect landing.

examples.japanese: ⟦{探査機|たんさき}→探査機：25715_tansaki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{月面|げつめん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{無事|ぶじ}→無事：01602_buji⟧{着地|ちゃくち}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦という→という：09577_toiu⟧⟦ニュース→ニュース：04437_nyuusu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{世界中|せかいじゅう}→世界中：10171_sekaijuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{伝|つた}えられた→伝える：01220_tsutaeru⟧。
examples.english: News that the probe had safely landed on the lunar surface was reported around the world.

notes:
USAGE:
{着地|ちゃくち} is used with ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ as an intransitive suru-verb. The landing surface takes ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {着地|ちゃくち}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to land, to touch down)
- {着地|ちゃくち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{決|き}める→決める：00858_kimeru⟧ (to stick a landing)
- {着地|ちゃくち}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{失敗|しっぱい}→失敗：01636_shippai⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to fail a landing)
- {軟|なん}{着地|ちゃくち} (soft landing)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {着地|ちゃくち}: landing (general, from air to ground)
- ⟦{着陸|ちゃくりく}→着陸：05982_chakuriku⟧: landing (specifically aircraft on a runway)
- {着水|ちゃくすい}: landing on water (seaplanes, spacecraft)
